notes: Form 1040 line 6a equals the closed ordinary SSA-1099 box-5 family subtotal (W1). v2 adds a guard: the rule publishes only when the SSA-1099 benefits family (ssa1099.benefits) is closed at the current horizon (require_closed). Line 6b and below were already held by the benefits worksheet. Why: collect reads closure only when its set is empty; with any member recorded it sums what is present and never asks whether the set is complete, so v1 published a partial line 6a when a family had a recorded amount and an unanswered or stale closure. With the guard, an unclosed family blocks this rule SOURCE_SET_UNCLOSED, naming the first unclosed set in the order listed, and every line that reads it waits. A complete return (every family closed at the current horizon, or closed empty) publishes exactly what v1 did. Residual, not closed here: a closure attested true over an amount that was never recorded still publishes the smaller sum, because the engine cannot tell a blank from 'nothing'.
